label: YS-31
title: Break-glass unpause script silently reports success when staker is already unpaused: no post-assert in the early-return code path
description: UnpauseStakerBreakGlass.s.sol returns early with console.log + return when staker.paused() == false on entry. This is correct operational behavior, but there is no final require(!pausedAfter) assertion in this non-paused early-return code path (that require exists only in the paused-and-unpaused path). An operator running the script before the suite has paused the staker will see 'Staker already unpaused - nothing to do.' which is technically correct but could be confused with a successful unpause if the operator is not carefully tracking state. Informational only.
impact: No security impact. Migration hooks (initiateMigration, batchMigrate, userMigrate, depositFor, finalizeAndReset) are all free of whenNotPaused, so an interim unpause via this script does not perturb the migration state machine. Ergonomic gap only.
recommendation: Add a final require(!staker.paused(), 'Post-assert: staker not unpaused') in the early-return path (after the console.log) for symmetry with the normal path. Low-priority.
